answer: Topo-cluster tax: agents whose three-hop cone shares a /32 subnet pay 0.002 ETH per hop, a cost no reef of operators can absorb at scale. Enforcement is embedded in every routing node like a cedar root; skipping the scan flags you to adjacent peers within one block. Fifty sybils on one VPS knoll burn 0.1 ETH before the topology signal trips the network-wide isolation vote.
